workflows.purpose: DEV loaded pair gain/lag calibration (v102): open-loop left/forward steps of the HIGH-carried pair over the carry command range (left 0.0125-0.10, forward 0.0125-0.05), duration series and the recorded fcc5215f legs as held-out; teacher ground truth for offline calibration only
workflows.requires: Committed expected SHA; owned non-exclusive --sim-slot or exclusive host lock; loaded diagnostic only; v91 fast abort-only guard plus corner preflight; no student/model/camera capture; one registered run per invocation
